C-R4-PERIODIC-COMPLETION-322.Summary: Make periodic task completion a direct domain transition for the executor, independent from optional evidence review, while preserving ACL, calendar/plan-fact projections and history.
C-R4-PERIODIC-COMPLETION-322.Problem: Periodic task status is currently mutated through the generic manager-only PATCH which requires a reason, while attaching an optional report forces status submitted and report review forces completed/rework. An executor therefore cannot finish their own ordinary periodic task in one action, and optional evidence acts as a mandatory approval workflow. The adaptive UI also treats periodic edit status as learnable.

Goals.Goal: Add explicit complete/reopen transitions with no required text or file.
Allow the owner/executor, its manager chain and admin to perform completion transitions without granting them rights to dates, ownership, delegation or cancellation.
Synchronize periodic task, both calendar projections and live Plan/Fact state transactionally.
Keep report/evidence attachment and review optional and independent from task completion state.
Record completion history in audit while preventing completion/cancel/return status values from adaptive preference learning.

Constraints.Constraint: No SQLite migration, destructive reset or VERSION change.
Generic PATCH remains restricted to the existing manageable/control permission.
Cancelled tasks cannot be completed or reopened through the direct completion action.
Existing evidence records and report review history are preserved.
No LLM, Internet or new runtime dependency.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Remove legacy submitted/rework values from stored historical records.
Change assignment completion, ownership hierarchy or organization ACL.
Make report review a prerequisite for completion.
Change due dates, task ownership or manager through the transition endpoint.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The task owner completes an open/submitted/rework periodic task with one complete action and no reason/file.
A completed task can be returned to open work with one reopen action; cancelled tasks reject both.
A stranger receives 403; generic PATCH reassignment/date permission remains unchanged.
Task status/completed_at and periodic_task/periodic_task_plan calendar projections change in the same transaction; Plan/Fact reflects the new status on the next read.
Attaching or reviewing an optional report no longer changes the task status.
Audit/history records the transition actor and before/after state.
No completion/cancel/reopen transition writes or reapplies a learned UI preference.
Desktop and mobile inspector expose one compact Выполнено or Вернуть в работу action; no modal and no animation are added, compatible with prefers-reduced-motion.
Auth/ACL regression, targeted unit/integration and ordinary CI/GRACE pass on one exact head.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head evidence proves owner/manager/stranger ACL, one-click transition projections, optional evidence independence and never-learn status behavior.
